route before refinement instead of forcing all items through skill-refiner.","Use old evals/tests only as evidence during diagnosis, not as the optimization goal; define fresh with/without or baseline validation for selected Skills before any edits.","After strategy confirmation, a real run must produce and validate skill-refiner-result.json or equivalent structured result evidence before claiming completion."],"risk_notes":["The user request is a batch 'do everything automatically' instruction; executing it would blur ownership, overwrite routing decisions, and optimize against stale or unverified signals.","Without real usage scenes, consumers, failure samples, and quality dimensions, bulk edits can improve wording while damaging actual Skill behavior.","Read-only dry run means no lifecycle closure or completion claim is allowed; only the next gate and owner can be decided."],"reason_summary":"This is an unsafe broad batch optimization request over many existing Skills. The correct skill-refiner posture is to defer blanket automation, require bounded scope plus quality standard / real scene evidence, and route each candidate by owner before any refinement."}
